headline: US-Iran Conflict Nears Critical Point as Strait of Hormuz Blockade Threatens Global Chip Supply and Fuels Helium Crisis.
summary: The escalating three-week US-Iran conflict is on the verge of blockading the Strait of Hormuz, directly threatening to cripple Taiwan's semiconductor industry and thereby the global tech supply chain. This geopolitical instability is also causing a severe helium shortage, impacting critical chip manufacturing and data center infrastructure worldwide.
